h1: Custom Stadium Blankets for Branded Comfort & Visibility
metaDescription: Order custom stadium blankets for events, promotions & employee gifts. Durable fleece, sherpa & picnic styles with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml:
Custom stadium blankets are built from materials that hold up to outdoor use and repeated washing. Fleece options like the Fraser Fleece Blanket and Heathered Fleece Blanket offer lightweight warmth, while sherpa styles such as the Two-Tone Sherpa and Velvet Sherpa Blanket add a plush, premium feel. For outdoor events, sand-repellent and roll-up picnic blankets provide practical features that keep blankets clean and easy to carry. These construction choices directly affect decoration quality and longevity, making material selection a key decision for bulk buyers.

Marketing directors use branded stadium blankets as high-visibility giveaways at sports events, concerts, and outdoor festivals. HR directors choose them for employee appreciation programs and holiday gifts that teams actually use. Safety managers and business owners order them for company picnics, charity walks, and client appreciation campaigns. With options for full-color heat transfer, screen printing, or embroidery, your logo can be applied to nearly any blanket style in quantities that fit your budget and timeline.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom stadium blankets, focus on fabric weight, size, and care instructions. Fleece blankets (typically 200–300 GSM) offer softness and packability, while sherpa blankets provide heavier warmth for cold-weather events. Picnic blankets often include a waterproof backing and sand-repellent fabric, making them ideal for outdoor venues. Check the finished dimensions: a standard 50x60 inch throw works for individual use, while larger sizes suit families or shared seating. Always request a material swatch before placing a bulk order to confirm color accuracy and hand feel.

Materials & Durability

Polyester fleece is the most common material for promotional blankets due to its durability, color retention, and resistance to pilling. Sherpa blankets use a textured polyester backing that mimics wool without the weight. For outdoor use, look for blankets with stitched edges and reinforced corners to prevent fraying. The KOOZIE® Field Blanket and Roll-Up Fleece Blanket are designed for repeated folding and transport, while the Sand Repellent Blanket uses a tight weave that shakes clean easily. These material choices directly impact how well your logo holds up after multiple washes.

Common Use Cases

Marketing directors often order custom stadium blankets for season-ticket holder gifts, stadium giveaways, and corporate sponsorship activations. HR directors use branded blankets for employee milestone awards, holiday gifts, and wellness program incentives. Business owners distribute them at trade shows, client appreciation events, and company picnics. Safety managers may order them for outdoor safety stand-down events or as part of cold-weather PPE kits. Each use case benefits from a specific blanket style: fleece for indoor comfort, picnic for outdoor practicality, and sherpa for premium gifting.

Decoration Options

Full-color heat transfer is the most popular decoration method for fleece and sherpa blankets because it allows photographic detail and gradient colors without a heavy hand. Screen printing works well on smooth fleece surfaces for simple one- or two-color logos. Embroidery is best for blankets with a tight weave or a border where a small logo can be stitched. For picnic blankets with a waterproof backing, avoid embroidery that might puncture the liner; instead, use heat transfer or a sewn-on patch. Always test decoration on a sample blanket to confirm adhesion and color vibrancy.

Quantity & Pricing

Bulk custom stadium blanket orders typically start at 50–100 units, with lower per-unit pricing at 250, 500, and 1,000+ quantities. Wholesale pricing for fleece blankets often ranges from $8–$15 each, while sherpa and picnic styles run $12–$25 depending on features. To maximize your budget, choose a mid-weight fleece blanket with a single-color screen print for the lowest cost per unit. If you need full-color branding, heat transfer adds $1–$3 per blanket but delivers superior visual impact. Order samples before committing to a large run to verify quality and decoration placement.

Common Buying Mistakes

A frequent mistake is choosing a blanket style that doesn't match the event environment. For example, a plush sherpa blanket is not ideal for a beach giveaway because it attracts sand. Another pitfall is overlooking blanket size: a 40x60 inch throw may feel small for tall users. Always confirm dimensions with your supplier. Finally, check the care label: some blankets require gentle cycle washing, which may not suit high-traffic giveaways. Communicating your use case to your account manager helps avoid these issues and ensures you receive the right product for your audience.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom stadium blankets?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities typically start at 50 to 100 units for stock blanket styles. Custom shapes or unique materials may require higher minimums. Contact your account manager to confirm MOQ for your chosen blanket and decoration method.

faqs.q: Which decoration method works best for fleece blankets?
faqs.a: Full-color heat transfer is the most popular choice for fleece because it produces vibrant, detailed logos without a heavy feel. Screen printing works well for simple one- or two-color designs. Embroidery is best for small logos on blanket borders or tags.

faqs.q: How long does production take for branded stadium blankets?
faqs.a: Production lead time is usually 10 to 15 business days after artwork approval, depending on order size and decoration complexity. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Always confirm timelines with your representative.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available. You can order a blank sample to evaluate fabric and size, or a decorated sample to check logo placement and color accuracy. Sample costs are typically deducted from your final order.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a fleece blanket and a sherpa blanket?
faqs.a: Fleece blankets are smooth on both sides, lightweight, and quick-drying, making them ideal for indoor use or mild weather. Sherpa blankets have a fluffy, wool-like texture on one side for extra warmth and a plush feel. Both are polyester-based and machine washable.
